what: Examiner, 2026-11-24, from default.xbe only. (1) 'flow_create': the create-function argument (7th, after the subsystem's name string) of the 36 static descriptors built by 0x000EB3A0 (thiscall, ret 0x28, forwards all 10 arguments to 0x000EA890) from __xc initializers; 'known' says whether the start was already in callgraph/registry/extra_function_starts. (2) 'aligned_after_ret': 16-aligned addresses that follow ret/jmp plus int3/nop padding inside a currently known open function, are not the target of any jump in that function, and are not referenced as dwords from inside it (switch tables excluded); referenced_by = call (some call instruction targets it), data (a dword in .text/.rdata/.data outside the function points at it), none. v2 (2026-11-24): per-VA fields prev (last non-padding instruction before the start), tail (last non-padding instruction before the next known start) and verdict. Jump tables = every imm32 used as jmp [reg*4+imm32]; entries of those tables are case labels, the tables themselves are data.
